Answer · Auth0 cost by MAU (no SSO)

10k users: $0/mo on Free · 50k users: $3,500/mo on Essentials (B2C) · 100k users: Enterprise only (contact sales) — top published tier is 50k MAU.

  • 1k users · no SSO: Free lists $0/mo: tie at $0 with 13 other plans.
  • 10k users · 1 SSO: Free lists $0/mo: tie at $0 with 3 other plans (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection).
  • 50k users · 5 SSO: no verifiable plan for this scenario.
  • 100k users · 10 SSO: no verifiable plan for this scenario.

As of 2026-11-07, from 29 verified plan rows. SSO users: Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform bill SAML/OIDC per SSO user, not per connection (first 50 free, then $0.015 per SSO user a month). Their SSO results here assume 200 SSO users per connection (5 connections = 1,000 SSO users). See how 1,000 or 2,000 per connection changes the result or set your own. B2B: every SSO result assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection (members = its SSO users, 200 by default). Published org caps and fees are applied, e.g. Clerk’s $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on above 20 members or 100 orgs, Auth0 Free’s 5-org cap, Descope $1/tenant over 35; plans over a cap are left out. Auth0 for Startups: year 1 free if eligible, then the list-price cliff

Auth0 for Startups (auth0.com/startups, read 2026-10-31) gives eligible startups one year of the B2B Professional plan free, up to 100,000 MAU, with 5 Enterprise Connections, Enterprise MFA and inbound SCIM. Eligibility (Auth0’s words): venture-backed with less than $5M in funding; less than $1M in annual recurring revenue; less than two years from the date of incorporation; not valid for existing paid Auth0/Okta customers or past program members. When the 12 months end, list price applies: B2B Professional with 3 SSO connections is $800/mo at 1,000 MAU, $1,500/mo at 5,000 MAU, $2,400/mo at 10,000 MAU; above 10,000 MAU Auth0 publishes no B2B Professional price (contact sales). Not eligible? Nothing changes: list prices apply from month 1. Our rankings always use list prices.

Auth0 pricing FAQ

How much does Auth0 cost at 10k, 50k and 100k users?

10k users: $0/mo on Free; 50k users: $3,500/mo on Essentials (B2C); 100k users: Enterprise only (contact sales) — top published tier is 50k MAU. Cheapest verified Auth0 plan, monthly USD list price, no SSO, from https://auth0.com/pricing (checked 2026-10-31).

How does Auth0 count billable users?

Auth0 bills by MAU: Monthly active users (external). Paid plans are sold in published MAU tiers (500 up to 50k B2C / 20k B2B); usage between tiers is billed at the next tier up. Enterprise is contact sales.

Does Auth0 charge for SCIM / Directory Sync?

Free: Inbound SCIM included (uses the customer’s enterprise connection), no separate fee. Essentials (B2C): Not offered on this plan. Professional (B2C): Not offered on this plan. Essentials (B2B): Inbound SCIM included (uses the customer’s enterprise connection), no separate fee. Professional (B2B): Inbound SCIM included (uses the customer’s enterprise connection), no separate fee.
